# orchestra_azure_federated_credentials (Data Source)

The workspace's Azure workload-identity federation details, for granting Orchestra access to Azure compute without a stored secret.

Use these to configure a federated identity credential on an Azure app registration — for example `azuread_application_federated_identity_credential`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The subject and audience to trust when configuring an Azure federated
# identity credential for Orchestra.
data "orchestra_azure_federated_credentials" "this" {}

output "azure_federated_subject" {
  value = data.orchestra_azure_federated_credentials.this.subject_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `audience` (String) The audience Azure must accept on the federated credential, used as `audiences`.
- `subject_id` (String) The subject identifier Azure must match on the federated credential, used as the `subject` of an `azuread_application_federated_identity_credential`.
